items.en: Liquid Glass material with Glass intensity, manual opacity and Dynamic adaptation; the music, Discord and timer satellites use the same liquid surface
System volume sits below the app rows as the last row; the mixer header keeps the output picker
Hide the notch from OBS and screen captures; the notch stays usable to you and Ctrl+Alt+H toggles it
Long notifications grow horizontally to fit their text while keeping the compact height
Readable text scrim and shadows when Dynamic adaptation makes the glass very clear
Corners option removed; rounded corners are permanent
Master volume controls the real Windows endpoint; per-app mixer rows stay fully visible
Clicking the expanded notch closes the attached panel while keeping the notch open; clicking inside the panel leaves it open, outside closes both
Attached panels stay open when you click inside them or on the expanded notch; only a click outside closes them
Long-holding Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or Power no longer fires a click on release — the tile state stays unchanged
NSIS/installed builds set an explicit app ID so Windows notification access can be granted; if it is denied, a button opens the Windows settings directly
Compact liquid-glass notification capsule: real app icon, app name, title and a two-line message; click opens the app, swipe dismisses, swipe down opens the notch
Circular app icons for every notification; translucent glass without the extra black rectangular layer
Hindi/Devanagari lyrics are no longer clipped at the top or bottom
Global UI font in Settings: Inter, Onest, System or Mono
Horizontal glass Power strip; battery bolt when the charger is connected, 1-second sync, low-battery alert under 20% and a single charge chime
Audio sessions: play/pause on the left, click switches the Now Playing session, clicking the caret again closes the panel
Fixed shape for every Settings page; memory is released only after 60 s closed, never while the notch is open
Five selectable clock faces (Stacked, Split, Scatter, Classic, Word); the closed pill grows and shrinks with time, date, day and weather without clipping

Lyric lab: Word by Word (default) and Apple Music, plus seven effects (Fill, Glitch, Liquid, Spotlight, Spark, Orbit, Ambient); three equalizers (Bars, Mirror, Ticks); four behind-glows (Wave, Aurora, Bokeh, Leaves)
Line changes with a 50 ms lead and a short crossfade; Spotlight keeps one active word, Orbit and Ambient follow the word clock
LRCLIB word-level timings (lyricsfile lines[].words) drive karaoke words when present; line-only LRCs use the character-weighted estimate
Night sky glow removed (the heaviest one); autumn leaves and bokeh light leaks stay in the pill
Visualization stays in the closed pill only; the expanded player no longer draws a background layer, saving memory; full-pill glow always on
"Custom power in games" removed; power modes stay manual in the notch
Font settings: Caption, Footnote, Body, Title and Display each with size/weight sliders, live preview and reset; 0 means default
Separate lyric pill: preview, minimum width, auto width (on by default), height and weight; better LRCLIB matching by duration plus Instrumental/Music states
Gaming overlay: live preview, FPS/CPU/temperature/GPU/RAM toggles, Text/Bars/Graph styles, dynamic width, transparency and custom power while gaming
Silent mode as a ghost (click-through, triple-click wakes), presentation shortcut and tray items, motion intensity, FPS unlock and Performance page
Polish: no weather tint, uniform closed-pill weight, overlap-free lyric animations, real Discord icon and vault Hello fix

Custom now uses Lenovo profile 0xFF – the real Vantage custom mode (purple) instead of performance + cooling; if the model rejects 5 it falls back to performance + active cooling. The selection survives restarts
Notch and Display stay separate pages; Settings stays clean
Custom now really stays active: WinZal remembers the choice, applies Lenovo performance + active cooling and restores it after app or PC restarts – no snapping back to Max
Notch and Display are separate pages again: Notch = idle style and size, Display = visibility, monitor/position, DND, gaming/FPS, recording dots and presentation mode
Removed more long helper texts from Settings; the UI stays calm and clean
Unlock FPS once: the app creates a Windows logon task that starts the helper after every restart without another UAC prompt – FPS, temperatures and fan modes stay unlocked
Custom power now uses Lenovo's own custom fan mode (4) and starts the helper automatically the first time you choose it; if the model does not expose it, Performance (3) is used
The FPS row shows “Unlocked” again after a restart once the logon task has started the helper
Wi-Fi now connects saved networks through the same Windows WLAN API as the taskbar; for new networks the notch briefly gives up its topmost slot so the Windows password dialog is usable
Custom is now a Lenovo-only mode: it uses Lenovo thermal mode 4 on the stable Windows Balanced plan; the old WinZal power plan is no longer created and is removed from the system
Removed long helper texts from Settings (Discord developer instructions, duplicate FPS notes, update/save paragraphs) for a calmer, cleaner UI
Line now has its own length and thickness sliders: switching between Notch and Line remembers each look's own size, with a matching preview
Windows Hello now appears above the notch and accepts input; the notch temporarily gives up its always-on-top slot while the Hello dialog is open
Custom power mode now stays active after a restart: Windows' performance overlay no longer resets the custom plan to Balanced/Max
After a restart only the current version starts; old portable copies are removed and autostart plus the Start menu point to the new installation
Removed the old focus click-through leftovers and unused files; the brand image is compressed – less baggage, calmer animations and a smaller package

Notch and Appearance are separate pages again: Notch holds idle style, length/width, visibility, Do Not Disturb, gaming/FPS and presentation mode; Appearance holds theme, island style, accents, clock, material, corners, interaction and performance
All features from both pages are preserved; Appearance reset now leaves the notch size untouched
Windows Do Not Disturb is now real: the moon button, triple-clicking the notch, Overview, Settings and the tray switch the system-wide mode (PriorityOnly/Unrestricted)
New Notch page gathers idle style, length and width with a live preview, theme, material, corners, visibility and interaction in one place
Clipboard cards in the new glass layout: smaller transparent buttons for copy, pin and remove, an image preview in the middle and a large Ask AI pill; pinned entries survive clearing

Shelf adopts the clipboard layout: copy top-left, Explorer and remove top-right, image preview in the middle and the large Ask AI pill; the new chat icon replaces the old sparkle everywhere AI appears
Copy now shows an animated check-pop with a short ring instead of the green dot; all card buttons spring smoothly on hover
Lyric pill in Compact, Normal or Long; width changes run on a smooth width spring without jitter, and word-by-word lyrics get a gentle bounce
The clock emphasizes both hour digits at the same size and weight in the closed notch and in Overview (12 instead of 1 + 2)
FPS unlock remembers a running helper; Settings no longer shows it as locked after reopening
Connections is now called Discord; removed hover helper texts from the power menu
Custom theme now shows only the working color picker; the ready-made theme cards and extra color row are removed
The color picker now reliably follows dragging in the field and hue slider, including in WebView2
Word-by-word lyrics: softer spring, stronger blur and a gentle scale from below for a much smoother rise
New in-app color picker for the Custom theme: HSV field, hue slider, HEX and RGB fields instead of the system dialog
Ready-made Mocha, Matcha, Monochrome and Soft Yellow themes; Monochrome and Soft Yellow also in the color row
Copy confirmations now use green dots instead of checkmarks
FPS pill: live load bars fill the middle; CPU temperature uses the real Lenovo sensor when the helper is running
New “Custom” theme: pick any island color with a large color selector; text, menus and icons switch between light and dark automatically
Removed the separate “Resting notch” and “Open notch” colors; the theme now controls both
Settings use less empty space on short pages such as About
Windows Hello now unlocks the vault automatically on open; names, usernames and all entries stay sealed until unlocked
CPU temperature appears in the FPS pill, with an ACPI fallback when Lenovo GameZone provides no sensors
Paste images straight into the open AI chat with Ctrl+V; they appear as an attachment and go to the model with your next message
Large screenshots are scaled down to 1600 px to keep memory use and saved chats small
Ask actions are larger and sit at the lower right: AI settings, chat history and new chat
History is easier to read; the heading and timestamps have more contrast
Equalization Accent and every color swatch now accept any custom color through the color picker
The Dock icons and Subtext sliders were removed; both stay fixed at 100%
The enlarged first clock digit now has clear space before the colon
The first digit of the closed clock is bolder and slightly larger
Chat saving can be switched off in Settings and in the history menu; new turns then stay in memory only
Existing chats stay readable when saving is off and can be deleted one by one or all at once with confirmation
Ask saves conversations locally — history reopens the latest chat or an earlier one
Each conversation is a small file on disk; only the open chat is kept in memory
Signed updates install automatically in the background; switch it off under Settings → Updates
Continuous 10–15 px lyric slider; the pill and visualizer grow with it
Five visualizers with live previews: Wave, Pulse, Dots, Ripple and Aurora — in the cover accent
Dark, Light and System themes across the whole UI
FPS overlay only for Genshin Impact or a custom .exe
Apple Music is the default animation, plus Word by word and Reveal with previews
GPU and RAM values in the gaming pill are clearly separated
Lyrics widen the closed pill instead of fading readable lines; very long lines scroll slowly
Gaming and music: a separate circular equalizer floats left of the FPS pill
Power menu with Saver, Balanced, Max and purple Custom; Max and Custom only while plugged in
Signed updates straight from GitHub — after a one-time manual install of 1.6.1
Far less memory while the notch is closed – about 80 instead of 300 MB
Quieter in the background: barely any processor use while idle
Turned-off tools like Hardware or Clipboard no longer run in the background
A thin line instead of the notch as your everyday look – a finished timer still pops open
Coming next: version 2.0.0 with lots of new things. The closed notch will show much more – downloads and updates, app status, progress of Claude Code and other AI CLIs, widgets and more
Volume per app in the player – like the Windows mixer
Click the cover or title to open the app that's playing
Temperature in °C or °F, clock in 24 or 12 hours
Presentation mode: hides clipboard, balances and vault while you share your screen
What's new, right here – including versions you skipped
Focus mode as a thin line at the edge – and on/off right from the tray menu
Clicks right below the notch no longer get lost
Clipboard images use far less memory
Covers change smoothly, in the closed notch and in the player
Album covers from Spotifast show up
Smoother animations when opening and closing
Discord guide now includes the http://localhost redirect
Unlock the vault with Windows Hello – face, fingerprint or Windows PIN
Additionally AES-256 encrypted via the security chip (TPM)
New: vault for passwords and 2FA codes, encrypted on your PC
Add 2FA with a screenshot of the QR code and Ctrl + V
Copied passwords stay out of every history and clear after 30 s
First release
